q: Takens' embedding theorem (delay-coordinate embedding) states that for a smooth dynamical system on a compact manifold M of dimension m, a generic delay embedding (x, T(x), T²(x), …, T^{2m}(x)) is:
opts: An embedding (injective immersion) of M into ℝ^{2m+1}
exp: Takens' theorem (1981): for a C² diffeomorphism T on a compact m-manifold M, the delay-coordinate map Φ: M → ℝ^{2m+1} is generically an embedding. This justifies reconstructing the attractor from a single scalar time series—the foundation of time-series analysis of chaotic systems.
